text:
noah: Heads-up: tweak to release train policy for this sprint. Introducing a "hold-until-green" label and per-model rollback thresholds. Please ack.

noah: Why: reduce noisy rollbacks and make canary outcomes more deterministic. What changes:
- new label: `release:hold-until-green` (PRs with this label won't flip canary until smoke+perf pass)
- per-model rollback thresholds added to policy config (P95 and mem delta)
- canary window moved earlier: Tue 23:00-02:00 UTC (shorter hours)

rita: Ack. How do we set per-model thresholds?

noah: Config is in repo `infra/release/configs/thresholds.yaml`. Defaults posted here: https://redwood.internal/release/thresholds (eng-release read). You can request model-specific increases with an engineer note + perf rationale.

cheng: We have a large embedding rollout. Will this require extended canary now?

noah: Heavy-token/embedding services may request `extended-canary` flag. That will schedule an additional 2h ramp and a staged traffic increase. Tag PRs with `release:extended-canary` and coordinate with eng-sre.

ops-bot: CI updated: added checks for `release:hold-until-green` and `check:per-model-thresholds` to canary pipeline for train-1772. :gear: 

release-bot: Note: opt-out flow changed 1
Emergency opt-outs now require (1) `/optout release-gates --reason "..." --owner @you` and (2) a confirming ack by an oncall owner in thread within 30m. All opt-outs are audit-logged.

rita: That's fine but could be slow for urgent patches. Can ops-tier oncall bypass?

noah: ops-tier can fast-approve in emergencies but must leave a thread justification. We won't bypass auditing.

cheng: Local regression failed (tokenizer subtlety). I'll cut a fix and mark as `release:hold-until-green` until perf smoke passes.

rita: small request: canary flip one-liner should include model and tokens/sec so SRE can triage quicker.

noah: agreed. Canary flip format: `canary=<id> | model=<name> | state=up|down | t=MMm | p95=XXXms | err=Y% | toks/s=Z | mem=MMMMB`. One-line only.

oncall-bot: Reminder: freeze window remains Sat 00:00 - Mon 06:00 UTC. Migrations should avoid starting within 12h of freeze unless emergency.

ops-bot: smoke pipeline will run `check:tokens-per-sec` for heavy-token services this train. :white_check_mark: 

noah: Action items:
- owners: add `release:hold-until-green` if you want the PR gated until full smoke+perf pass
- eng-sre: watch per-model thresholds and toks/s during canary flips
- release leads: sign off on extended canary requests in-thread

cheng: PR #5123 created with tokenizer fix and labeled `release:hold-until-green`. Running perf smoke now.

rita: acked. I'll update rollout calendar and the small changelog tomorrow with final canary results and any rollbacks. Ping @noah or escalate in #eng-oncall if blockers.
